# Additional graphs and tables with all fish used

## Gate statistics

```{r}
gate %>%
  group_by(exp.gate, node, trend, periode) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(node, exp.gate, trend) %>%
  summarise(median=round(median(n)/60)) %>%
  arrange(trend) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = trend, values_from = median)  %>%
  kable(caption="Median duration of different phases (min) per experiment")
```

## Number of individuals (unique tags) at different antennas and locations

```{r}
comp_dir %>% 
  group_by(exp,node) %>%
  summarise(unieke_tags = n_distinct(tag_code)) %>% 
  arrange(node) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp, values_from = unieke_tags) %>%
  kable(caption="Number of individuals (unique tags) at different antennas and locations")
```

## Statistics concerning the trajectory from the lower basin to the lower antenna

```{r}
comp_dir %>% 
  dplyr::filter(last_sequence == "basin down-antenna_down") %>% 
  mutate(travel_time=round(travel_time),
         since_open=round(since_open),
         opening=round(opening,digits=2)) %>% 
  group_by(tag_code) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(loop = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(exp,tag_code,loop) %>%
  dplyr::select(exp,travel_time,min_det,max_det,since_open,opening,trend,loop) %>% 
  kable(caption="Travel time (min) to move up the fish spiral calculated as the time difference between the last detection at the lower antenna and the first at the upper antenna. The time since the upper valve opened and the first detection at the upper antenna are given. The opening (cm) at which the firt detection at the upper antenna is noted is also given. Some fish went up and down several times. Subsequent trajectories are numbered under loop.",longtable=TRUE) %>% 
  kable_styling(latex_options="scale_down") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", box_css = "border: 0px;")
```

## Statistics concerning the trajectory from the lower to the upper antenna

```{r}
comp_dir %>% 
  dplyr::filter(last_sequence == "antenna_down-antenna_up") %>% 
  mutate(travel_time=round(travel_time),
         since_open=round(since_open),
         opening=round(opening,digits=2)) %>% 
  group_by(tag_code) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(loop = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(exp,tag_code,loop) %>%
  dplyr::select(exp,travel_time,min_det,max_det,since_open,opening,trend,loop) %>% 
  kable(caption="Travel time (min) to move up the fish spiral calculated as the time difference between the last detection at the lower antenna and the first at the upper antenna. The time since the upper valve opened and the first detection at the upper antenna are given. The opening (cm) at which the firt detection at the upper antenna is noted is also given. Some fish went up and down several times. Subsequent trajectories are numbered under loop.",longtable=TRUE) %>% 
  kable_styling(latex_options="scale_down") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", box_css = "border: 0px;")
```

## Arrival time at different antennas

```{r}
comp_dir %>% 
  group_by(exp,node,tag_code) %>%
  summarise(eerste_detectie=min(min_det)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = node, values_from = eerste_detectie) %>% 
  dplyr::select(tag_code,antenna_down,antenna_up,`basin up`) %>%
  kable(caption="Time of first detection per fish on the top and bottom antenna",longtable=TRUE) %>% 
  kable_styling(latex_options="scale_down")
```

## Number of unique tags per sequence

```{r}
comp_dir %>% 
  arrange(node) %>%
  group_by(exp,last_sequence) %>%
  summarise(unieke_tags = n_distinct(tag_code)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp, values_from = unieke_tags) %>%
  kable(caption="Number of individuals (unique tags) per sequence")
```

## Arrival time at the different antennas during the day

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10,}
ggplot(comp_dir %>% 
  dplyr::filter(node %in% c("antenna_down","antenna_up")) %>% 
  mutate(hour_min_det=lubridate::hour(min_det)) %>%
  group_by(exp,node,hour_min_det) %>%
  summarise(unieke_tags = n_distinct(tag_code)),
    aes(x=hour_min_det, y=unieke_tags)) + 
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    facet_wrap(~ exp + node, ncol=2)
```

# Replicate graphs and tables but without the re-used fish

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
ggplot(data=comp_dir %>%
            dplyr::filter(last_sequence == "basin down-antenna_down" | last_sequence == "antenna_down-antenna_up") %>% 
            dplyr::filter(exp != "exp0") %>%
            dplyr::filter(is.na(travel_time)==FALSE) %>%
            dplyr::filter(!(abs(travel_time - median(travel_time)) > 1.5*sd(travel_time))) %>%
            dplyr::filter(hergebruikt==1) %>%
            arrange(tag_code,min_det) %>%
            group_by(tag_code,last_sequence) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(loop = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
            dplyr::filter(loop == 1),
          aes(as.factor(exp), travel_time),size = 0.5, color = "black") + 
geom_boxplot(linetype = 1, position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
facet_wrap(~last_sequence) +
ylab("Travel time (min)") + 
xlab("Experiment") + 
theme_bw() +
stat_summary(fun.data = give.n1, geom = "text", fun.y = median,
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) + 
stat_compare_means(comparisons = cmpr2024, method = "wilcox.test", symnum.args = symnum.args, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni", label='p.adj')
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
ggplot(data=comp_dir %>%
            dplyr::filter(last_sequence == "basin down-antenna_down" | last_sequence == "antenna_down-antenna_up") %>% 
            dplyr::filter(exp != "exp0") %>%
            dplyr::filter(is.na(peaksid)==FALSE) %>%
            dplyr::filter(hergebruikt==1) %>%
            arrange(tag_code,min_det) %>%
            group_by(tag_code,last_sequence) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(loop = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
            dplyr::filter(loop == 1),
          aes(x=as.factor(peaksid)),size = 0.5, color = "black") + 
geom_bar() + 
facet_wrap(~ last_sequence + exp, scales=c("free")) +
ylab("Number of fish entering lower valve") + 
xlab("Number of cycle since the experiment started") + 
theme_bw() + 
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) 
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
ggplot(data=comp_dir %>%
            dplyr::filter(last_sequence == "basin down-antenna_down" | last_sequence == "antenna_down-antenna_up") %>% 
            dplyr::filter(is.na(trend)==FALSE) %>%
            dplyr::filter(hergebruikt==1) %>%
            arrange(tag_code,min_det) %>%
            group_by(tag_code,last_sequence) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(loop = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
            dplyr::filter(loop == 1),
          aes(x=as.factor(exp),fill=trend,colour=trend),size = 0.5, color = "black") + 
geom_bar() +
facet_wrap(~last_sequence) +
ylab("Instances entering") + 
xlab("Experiment") +

```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
ggplot(data=gate %>%
  group_by(exp.gate, node, trend, periode) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(node, exp.gate, trend) %>%
  summarise(median=round(median(n)/60)) %>%
  right_join(comp_dir,by=c("node","exp.gate","trend")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(last_sequence == "basin down-antenna_down" | last_sequence == "antenna_down-antenna_up") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(is.na(trend)==FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(hergebruikt==1) %>%
  arrange(tag_code,min_det) %>%
  group_by(tag_code,last_sequence) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(loop = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::filter(loop == 1) %>%
  group_by(exp,last_sequence,trend) %>%
  summarize(n=n(),mean=mean(median)) %>%
  mutate(per.unit=n/mean),
  aes(x=as.factor(exp),y=per.unit,fill=trend,colour=trend),size = 0.5, color = "black") + 
geom_bar(stat="identity") +
facet_wrap(~last_sequence) +
ylab("Instances entering per minute") + 
xlab("Experiment") + 
theme_bw()
```
